_info: Test set for the GIT Helpdesk RAG project. 'answerable': false means the documents do NOT contain the answer, so the bot should refuse and create a ticket. 'page' is the 1-based PDF page where the answer is found.

questions.question: What is the last date to apply for admission in 2027?
questions.expected_answer: 30 June 2027

questions.question: How many seats are there in B.Tech Computer Science?
questions.expected_answer: 120 seats

questions.question: What is the minimum percentage needed in 12th for B.Tech admission?
questions.expected_answer: 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category), with Physics and Mathematics compulsory

questions.question: What documents do I need to bring at the time of admission?
questions.expected_answer: Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets, entrance scorecard, transfer certificate, migration certificate, Aadhaar card, category certificate (if applicable), six passport photos, medical fitness certificate, anti-ragging affidavit

questions.question: What is the application fee for a reserved category candidate?
When will the merit list be published?
questions.expected_answer: 15 July 2027

questions.question: If I withdraw my admission on 10 August 2027, how much refund will I get?
questions.expected_answer: 50% of the fees paid (withdrawal between 1 and 15 August)

questions.question: Can diploma holders get lateral entry into B.Tech?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, into the second year, with at least 55% aggregate in the diploma

questions.question: What is the total yearly fee for B.Tech CSE?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 1,60,000 (tuition 1,45,000 + development 10,000 + exam 5,000)

questions.question: What is the total yearly fee for MBA?
How much is the caution money and is it refundable?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 5,000, refundable after course completion

questions.question: How is the fee paid in installments?
questions.expected_answer: 60% at admission and 40% by 31 December

questions.question: What is the late fee for paying after the due date?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 100 per day, capped at Rs. 3,000

questions.question: Can I pay my fees in cash at the counter?
questions.expected_answer: No, cash is not accepted. Pay online, by demand draft or by NEFT

questions.question: I scored 96% in class 12. What scholarship can I get?
questions.expected_answer: 50% tuition fee waiver, renewable if CGPA is at least 7.5 and attendance at least 75%

questions.question: How much will a hostel student in a double-sharing room pay for hostel and mess per year?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 80,000 (double room) + Rs. 36,000 (mess) = Rs. 1,16,000

questions.question: What is the curfew time in the girls hostel?
questions.expected_answer: 8:30 PM (Kalpana Hostel)

questions.question: When are visitors allowed in the hostel?
questions.expected_answer: Sundays, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, in the visitor lounge only

questions.question: What is the fine for having alcohol in the hostel?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 10,000 fine and suspension from the hostel for one semester

questions.question: Can I keep an induction cooktop or kettle in my room?
questions.expected_answer: No, cooking appliances, kettles and heaters are not allowed. Unauthorised appliances attract a Rs. 2,000 fine

questions.question: Do I get a mess rebate if I go home for a week?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, Rs. 150 per day if absent for 5 or more consecutive days with prior written notice to the warden

questions.question: What are the mess timings for dinner?
questions.expected_answer: 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM

questions.question: What is the minimum attendance needed to sit in exams?
questions.expected_answer: 75% in each subject (80% for lab courses)

questions.question: My attendance is 70%. Can I still appear for the exam?
questions.expected_answer: Possibly, by applying for condonation (65% to 74%) with a valid reason or medical certificate, fee Rs. 500 per subject

questions.question: What marks do I need to pass a subject?
questions.expected_answer: At least 40% overall and at least 35% in the end-semester exam

questions.question: How many days do I have to apply for revaluation and what does it cost?
questions.expected_answer: Within 7 days of result declaration, Rs. 1,000 per paper

questions.question: What happens if I am caught cheating for the first time?
questions.expected_answer: Zero marks in that paper

questions.question: How many backlogs are allowed to be promoted to the next year?
questions.expected_answer: A student with more than 4 backlogs cannot be promoted, so up to 4 are allowed

questions.question: How many books can an undergraduate student borrow from the library?
questions.expected_answer: 3 books for 14 days

questions.question: What is the library fine for late return?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 2 per day per book

questions.question: What is the minimum percentage required to sit for campus placements?
questions.expected_answer: 60% aggregate with no active backlogs

questions.question: Where is the grievance cell and how long does it take to respond?
questions.expected_answer: Room 105, Administration Block; complaints answered within 7 working days

questions.question: What is the highest placement package offered last year?
questions.expected_answer: NOT IN DOCUMENTS - bot should refuse and create a ticket

questions.question: Who is the principal of the college?
questions.expected_answer: NOT IN DOCUMENTS - bot should refuse and create a ticket

questions.question: Does the college offer an M.Tech program?
questions.expected_answer: NOT IN DOCUMENTS - only B.Tech, MBA and BCA are listed. Bot should refuse rather than guess

questions.question: What is the fee for the Ph.D. program?
questions.expected_answer: NOT IN DOCUMENTS - bot should refuse and create a ticket

questions.question: Is there a swimming pool on campus?
questions.expected_answer: NOT IN DOCUMENTS - bot should refuse and create a ticket

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.expected_answer: OUT OF SCOPE - bot should not answer from general knowledge

questions.question: What is the Wi-Fi password of the library?
questions.expected_answer: NOT IN DOCUMENTS - bot should refuse and must not invent a password
